messages.subject: Help with independent records
parts:
Hello Everyone!!!!

I´m new using camtrapR and I have a question about independent records. I have this data of camera trap on csv format with the next information: station, Species, Date, Time, DateTimeOriginal and sampling event. In the past I have extracted independent records with the same kind of information using the next R code succesfully :

library(camtrapR)

base <- read.csv2 ("paisaje12021.csv", header = TRUE)
head(base)
names(base)      

#################### filter records 24H 
records_filter24_h <- camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence(intable = base,
                                                              deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord",
                                                              columnOfInterest = "Species",
                                                              stationCol = "Station",
                                                              minDeltaTime = 1440,
                                                              camerasIndependent = FALSE )

But now I'm using again this code and it fails to extract independent records and I have no idea why. At the begining I thought it was the format on the  DateTime Original column, but I think the format is correct and I run out of Ideas how to fix it. I'd appreciate any advice on this.
Thanks

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Help with independent records
parts:
Hi,

I believe the problem is that the date/time format in DateTimeOriginal does not match the expectation, since the date is sorted as DMY (instead of YMD) and the time is missing the seconds. I suppose you may have saved it in Excel in the meantime? Excel always removes the seconds. It may also have changed the date format.

Since assessTemporalIndependence is an internal function it doesn't check the date/time format. So what you'd need to do is reformat DateTimeOriginal to the expected format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

Do this by combining the Photo.Date and Photo.Time columns, and take care to change Date to YMD instead of DMY.

To be sure I'd need to know the error message you received though.
Best regards,

Jürgen
